text:
The Nifty 50 closed at 25,884.5, up 0.25% for the day and 2.6% over the past five sessions, while the broader Nifty 500 mirrored the move with the same 0.25% gain. Advances (251) slightly outpaced declines (242) and the breadth score stayed in the “HEALTHY” zone at 64.8, indicating a fairly broad rally. The India VIX fell 4.73% to 16.83, showing reduced volatility, and the 200‑day moving average (DMA) for Nifty sits at 24,003.9, well below the current level.

Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) added about ₹5,843 cr, extending a 20‑day buying streak, while Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) bought ₹5,631 cr for a second consecutive day. The FII‑FII futures net short of 88,469 contracts points to a modest bearish tilt in futures. Options data show a put‑call ratio (PCR) of 1.03 for Nifty, suggesting slightly more put interest, with the “max pain” level at 25,800 and a call wall at 26,000. Bank Nifty’s PCR is 0.87 (more call bias), max pain at 63,500 and a call wall at 66,000.

Watch the Nifty’s support at 25,753.7 (S1) and resistance at 25,995.1 (R1) for the next session; a break below S1 could test the 25,500 level, while a move above R1 may push toward the 26,400 target mentioned in market commentary. In Bank Nifty, the key levels are 63,210 (S1) and 63,982 (R1). Keep an eye on USD‑INR around 92.43 and Brent crude near $91.5, as commodity and currency moves often influence sentiment.
